title: Beetroot Pho with German Twist
description: A fusion of traditional Vietnamese Pho and a hearty German beetroot soup. Sweetly spiced and steamed to perfection.
instructions: Heat the sweetly spiced beef broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the sliced beetroot to the pot and cook for 10 minutes, or until tender.
Add the pho noodles to the pot and cook according to the package instructions.
Stir in the toasted caraway seeds and ground allspice.
Season the soup with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the beetroot pho hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
